world-politics.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Forces Search for Missing Airman After Iran Downs Jet
world-politics.summary: U.S. forces continue search-and-rescue efforts after Iran shot down a U.S. fighter jet, with one crew member still missing. The incident raises risks of escalation and potential prisoner issues as strikes and retaliation continue.

world-politics.title: Guterres warns of ‘wider war’ as Middle East conflict enters second month
world-politics.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned the world is on the edge of a wider war as the US and Israel continue strikes on Iran and Iran retaliates against Gulf states and shipping. He called for diplomacy and adherence to international law to stop the spiral of escalation.

world-politics.title: Trump Pledged a Quick End to the Iran War, but He Hasn't Explained How
world-politics.summary: The conflict with Iran is dragging on beyond early expectations, while the administration has offered limited detail on conditions for ending operations. Analysts say the lack of an exit plan complicates diplomatic off-ramps and risks entrenching a prolonged campaign.

world-politics.title: Europe's Options in the Strait of Hormuz: Few, and Risky
world-politics.summary: European governments are weighing ways to restore shipping through the Strait of Hormuz after the Iran war, but each option carries significant security and political risk. Officials are assessing naval escorts, diplomacy, and coordination mechanisms as energy and food prices react.

world-politics.title: Russia Claims Complete Control of Ukraine’s Luhansk Region
world-politics.summary: Russian officials claimed full control of Ukraine’s Luhansk region, one of the territories Russia annexed in 2022. Ukraine said Russia rejected a proposed Orthodox Easter truce while continuing drone attacks on civilian infrastructure.

us-politics.title: Trump Fires Attorney General Pam Bondi, Names His Former Criminal Defense Lawyer as Replacement
us-politics.summary: President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi and named Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche as acting attorney general. The shakeup follows reports of internal frustration and adds to broader turbulence inside the Justice Department.

us-politics.title: White House to Ask Congress for Record-Shattering $1.5 Trillion Pentagon Budget
us-politics.summary: The White House is preparing to request a $1.5 trillion Pentagon budget, the largest year-over-year jump in modern history. The plan includes funding for major weapons systems and missile defense while sparking debate over tradeoffs with domestic programs.

us-politics.title: Presidential Actions: ‘Liberating the Department of Homeland Security From the Democrat-Caused Shutdown’
us-politics.summary: The White House posted a new presidential memorandum on the ongoing DHS partial shutdown. The action frames the shutdown as driven by political conflict and outlines the administration’s stance on funding and operations.

us-politics.title: Presidential Actions: ‘Urgent National Action to Save College Sports’
us-politics.summary: A new executive order aims to address governance and enforcement issues in college athletics. The move signals greater federal engagement in NIL, eligibility, and related disputes.

us-politics.title: PBS NewsHour: Trump fires Attorney General Pam Bondi following turbulent tenure
us-politics.summary: PBS NewsHour reported on the dismissal of Attorney General Pam Bondi and the political fallout in Washington. The episode also covered the DHS funding standoff and developments related to the Ukraine war.

dfw-politics.title: Fort Worth violent crime reduction initiative expands ahead of World Cup
dfw-politics.summary: Fort Worth law enforcement is expanding Project Safe Neighborhoods to target violent crime, gangs, and drug trafficking along the I-35W corridor. The initiative is framed as a public safety push ahead of North Texas World Cup events later this year.

dfw-politics.title: FULL: Rapper Pooh Shiesty arrested in Dallas kidnapping
dfw-politics.summary: Federal authorities announced arrests tied to a robbery and kidnapping at a Dallas music studio, including the arrest of rapper Pooh Shiesty. Prosecutors allege the kidnapping was intended to pressure a contract dispute.

dfw-politics.title: Hit-and-run leaves Johnson County man dead
dfw-politics.summary: FOX 4 reported on a fatal hit-and-run in Johnson County, as family members mourn the victim. Authorities are asking for information to identify the driver.

dfw-politics.title: 1 dead in Fort Worth officer-involved shooting
dfw-politics.summary: An officer-involved shooting in Fort Worth left one person dead and temporarily shut down Highway 287. The roadway reopened later that evening as investigators worked the scene.

dfw-politics.title: Dallas-Fort Worth weather: rain, periodically heavy
dfw-politics.summary: The Dallas-Fort Worth area is seeing rain that is periodically heavy today, with temperatures around the upper 60s. Drivers should expect reduced visibility and slower travel in downpours.

ai-news.title: National Policy Framework turns AI preemption into a 2026 political fight
ai-news.summary: A new White House AI policy framework is fueling debate over whether federal standards should override state AI laws. The policy battle is shaping up around accountability, infrastructure, and limits on government influence over speech.

ai-news.title: AI Legislative Update: April 3, 2026
ai-news.summary: A weekly roundup tracks state-level AI bills, including chatbot disclosure and child safety proposals and restrictions on AI posing as mental health professionals. The update highlights rapid legislative movement ahead of session deadlines.

ai-news.title: AI News Briefs Bulletin Board for April 2026
ai-news.summary: A curated bulletin highlights April AI developments including MLPerf Inference v6.0 results, open web-agent tools, and research on model internal representations. It also points to new model and benchmarking activity across industry and academia.

ai-news.title: Crisis contractor for OpenAI, Anthropic eyes a move to combat extremism
ai-news.summary: The Economic Times reports on efforts to build tools that route users showing violent extremist tendencies toward deradicalization support. The initiative reflects growing legal and safety pressure on AI platforms.

ai-news.title: White House Releases a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence
ai-news.summary: Legal analysis summarizes the White House’s AI framework and potential impacts on regulation and compliance. The writeup focuses on how the framework could shape federal legislation and enforcement priorities.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon on Trump, running for office and Epstein (The Axios Show)
jpmorgan-chase.summary: In an Axios interview, JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon discussed the Iran conflict, dismissed the idea of running for office, and addressed broader political uncertainty. He also touched on leadership succession and how he’s thinking about the future.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon’s warning: more geopolitical risk for America than since WWII
jpmorgan-chase.summary: Dimon warned that the U.S. faces unusually high simultaneous risks and urged business leaders to speak more candidly. He said AI could add employment disruption on top of existing geopolitical and cyber threats.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorganChase to Host First-Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan announced it will report first-quarter 2026 results on April 14 with an earnings call at 8:30 a.m. ET. The release timing sets up a key read on bank credit trends and trading activity.

jpmorgan-chase.title: 2026 Company Update Transcript (Investor Relations)
jpmorgan-chase.summary: A transcript from JPMorgan’s 2026 company update outlines outlook assumptions, including net interest income expectations and expense guidance. Executives also discussed client growth, AI-related spending, and efficiency initiatives.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Extended interview: Jamie Dimon on AI, Iran and more (CBS Evening News)
jpmorgan-chase.summary: CBS aired an extended interview in which Dimon discussed AI adoption, the Iran war’s economic effects, and how large employers are approaching flexibility and productivity. The segment also covered workforce change driven by technology.

dfw-events.title: Deep Ellum Arts Festival (April 3–5, 2026)
dfw-events.summary: Deep Ellum’s annual arts and music festival runs April 3–5 with multiple stages, food vendors, and visual artists throughout the neighborhood. It’s one of the metroplex’s biggest spring outdoor events.

dfw-events.title: Fort Worth Main Street Arts Festival (April 16–19, 2026)
dfw-events.summary: The Main Street Arts Festival takes over downtown Fort Worth April 16–19 with a large juried art show, live music, and family programming. Expect street closures and big crowds in Sundance Square and nearby blocks.

dfw-events.title: EarthX (April 20–22, 2026)
dfw-events.summary: EarthX returns to Dallas April 20–22 with exhibits and speaker sessions focused on sustainability, conservation, and clean energy. The event includes educational programming and community activities.

dfw-events.title: Breakaway Music Festival Dallas 2026 (April 10–11)
dfw-events.summary: Breakaway Music Festival comes to Fair Park April 10–11 with two days of EDM performances and festival activities. Doors open at 3 p.m. each day and the event is 18+.

dfw-events.title: Dallas International Film Festival (April 23–30, 2026)
dfw-events.summary: The Dallas International Film Festival runs April 23–30 featuring screenings, filmmaker talks, and panel discussions around independent and international cinema. Multiple venues host programs across the week.

dfw-events.title: FoodieLand Food Festival - Dallas (April 17–19, 2026)
dfw-events.summary: FoodieLand’s traveling food festival lands at Fair Park April 17–19 with hundreds of vendors, games, and live entertainment. Tickets must be purchased online in advance.
